name: Live x Evil -Nessa no Prometheus-
original_name: Live x Evil  熱砂のプロメテウス
source:
You are a newly recruited Secret Ops member who's sent to a remote desert city to gather information on the activities of a rising terrorist group.

[From The Yaoi Treasure Trove]
translation:
你是一名刚刚加入秘密行动部队的成员，被派往遥远的沙漠城市，搜集一个正在崛起的恐怖组织的活动情报。

[摘自The Yaoi Treasure Trove]
